c74object.name: evi_velvetnoise
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Interpolating 'sparse noise' / 'velvet noise' audio source
c74object.description:
evi_velvetnoise is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_velvetnoise is also available in MSP as: evi.velvetnoise~.
This object can actually interpolate between 'sparse noise' and 'velvet noise' (at the first outlet, via the second 'mix' inlet), but also outlets both 'sparse' and 'velvet' simultaneously from auxilliary outlets. The 'sparse noise' is an alternative to the evi.audiodust~ algorithm. Wikipedia: 'Velvet noise is a sparse sequence of random positive and negative impulses, typically characterised by its density in taps/second. At high densities it sounds similar to white noise. However, it is perceptually smoother.'

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz @default 100. The frequency at which to internally sample the noise. Typically used at low frequencies but the 'velvet' algorithm responds well to any frequency.

geninlet.name: mix
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @default 0.5 @min 0 @max 1. The mix between 'sparse noise' (0) and velvet noise (1) out of the first (far left) outlet.

attribute.name: amplitude
attribute.description: The amplitude of the 'velvet noise' algorithm. Setting this to anything other than '1' (the default) would be atypical, but might be useful in mixing situations.
